Enumerate: the sourceArguments tuple in Modules/Scripted/SampleData/SampleData.py (GitHub release listing pages are blocked from this sandbox).

name: TotalSegmentator v2 dataset, cardiac-protocol subset (Zenodo 10047292)

n_scans.unit: contrast cardiac-protocol scans (46 'ct heart-thorakale aorta', 34 'ct aortic valve', 34 'ct heart', 13 'ct left artrium'); excludes the 3 'ct coronary arteries' (calcium scans). ~31 more thoracic/whole-body CTAs are T3

format: NIfTI, resampled to 1.5 mm isotropic (dataset-wide), inside one 23.6 GB zip
labels: 117-structure TotalSegmentator labels (heart chambers, aorta, etc.; no coronary label)
steps_to_access: Whole zip: https://zenodo.org/records/10047292/files/Totalsegmentator_dataset_v201.zip?download=1. Single cases without the full download: HTTP range-read the zip central directory and extract sXXXX/ct.nii.gz (script round2/scripts_Catalogues/rzip.py; tested). Case list with study_type: meta.csv inside the zip (extracted, 1,228 rows, ';'-separated).
provenance: University Hospital Basel (Siemens scanners). Round 1 (Repos.json) listed TotalSegmentator/TAVRP-PL as T3 'record read only'; this entry adds the study_type breakdown and image tests.
verified: meta.csv extracted by range read; 6 cases extracted and rendered (then deleted): s0738 'ct heart' = tight-FOV CCTA, blood pool ~540 HU (T1-like); s0270 'ct heart' = contrast cardiac CT (T1/T2); s0671 'ct left artrium' = contrast cardiac CT (T2); s0189 'ct aortic valve' = TAVI-type arterial CTA chest-abdomen-pelvis (T2/T3); s0230 'ct heart-thorakale aorta' = contrast chest CTA (T2/T3); s0085 'ct coronary arteries' = NON-contrast (calcium score).
notes: Largest open, CC BY cardiac-contrast pool found in this round (~127 scans) but every volume is resampled to 1.5 mm isotropic, so distal coronaries are lost; proximal/mid vessels visible on the CCTA-type 'ct heart' cases. Within-'ct heart' some may be calcium scans (1 of 2 sampled was CCTA, the other contrast cardiac); filter by HU of aortic root. Pick by meta.csv study_type; ~0.5-2 GB per 20 cases.

verified: Extracted Young_01 via range read (291 MB): whole-aorta CTA, 1148 slices 0.51x0.51x0.6 mm, chest-abdomen-pelvis-legs; arterial phase, aorta/heart enhanced (blood-pool component median ~356 HU). Deleted.
notes: High-resolution arterial CTA with heart in FOV; non-gated so coronaries blurred but proximal segments often visible. Skip Nat.zip (non-contrast).

name: Medical Segmentation Decathlon Task06_Lung (AWS s3://msd-for-monai)

n_scans.unit: chest CT (63 train + 32 test approx.; contrast phase varies)

steps_to_access: https://msd-for-monai.s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/Task06_Lung.tar (anonymous). Uncompressed tar: single cases can be range-read (rtar.py, tested). dataset.json lists cases.
